title: Magento 2 indexer stuck: recovery without losing orders
lede: A stuck Magento 2 indexer turns checkout into a minefield: wrong prices, missing products, ghost stock. Here is the recovery sequence that protects the orders already in flight.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of a paper Magento indexer run-sheet, order dockets, brass M2 plate and red wax seal on bone linen.
